summary: A Yes vote authorizes the Gilroy Unified School District to issue $295 million in bonds.

tax.text: A Yes vote authorizes the $295 million bond program and the associated property-tax repayment.
tax.quote: The tax rate per property owner is estimated to be $60 per $100,000 of assessed valuation.

schools.text: A Yes vote funds renovations, new construction, and other improvements at Gilroy Unified School District schools.
schools.quote: Measure M will provide our students with a better learning environment by making repairs and upgrades to existing classrooms and school facilities, many of which are also used and available to the community.

tax.text: A No vote rejects the bond program and its associated property-tax repayment.
tax.quote: The tax rate per property owner is estimated to be $60 per $100,000 of assessed valuation.

schools.text: A No vote does not authorize the proposed school-facility improvements through Measure M.
schools.quote: Measure M will provide our students with a better learning environment by making repairs and upgrades to existing classrooms and school facilities, many of which are also used and available to the community.
